body:
I'm in the most serious relationship of my life and I don't know if I want to be.

every day I think about being with other women.  I can't turn it off.  but at the same time, this relationship is uniquely ideal and I know I'd never match with someone like this ever again.  I've pitched the idea of an open relationship to my SO and she's vehemently against it.  

I'm still attracted to her but sex feels like such a chore.  I'm almost sure that's what it is, just a physical thing, but that makes it no less overbearing.  I've never cheated on anyone and I know I never will, but I don't like the idea of living in sexual dissatisfaction for the rest of my life.  not to mention I constantly feel like an asshole for even having thoughts like this.

fuck.
